title: Run manifest
description: Immutable resolved configuration and provenance for one run. Written once and never replaced. A run = ONE combination of language + task + transformation model/strategy + test-generation model/strategy + seed + pipeline variant. An axis may be null only when no stage in the run consumes it; null never means unconstrained.

task.description: The one concrete task fixed by this run. Multi-task experiments are expanded into one run per task.

transformation_model.description: The one value this run fixes for this axis, or null when the axis is not applicable to the stages this run executes. Null never means 'any value': a stage that needs an axis the run left null must refuse rather than select every value.

test_generation_model.description: The one value this run fixes for this axis, or null when the axis is not applicable to the stages this run executes. Null never means 'any value': a stage that needs an axis the run left null must refuse rather than select every value.

transformation_strategy.description: The one transformation-generation strategy fixed by this run, or null when no stage consumes it.

test_generation_strategy.description: The one semantic-test-generation strategy fixed by this run, or null when no stage consumes it.

experiment_config.description: Exact bounded-loop and feedback configuration selected for this run. Optional only so manifests recorded before this field was introduced remain readable.

input_hashes.description: Content hashes of the hand-authored inputs that decide the run's outcome: the reference transformation, the task contract, and the metamodels. Without them a stored result cannot be tied to the inputs it was produced from.

metamodels.description: Hash per metamodel file the task contract names, keyed by repository-relative path. The key is always present, so a run that recorded nothing is distinguishable from one that never recorded. It is empty exactly when the contract names no metamodel file at all — a task whose models are all metamodel-less, such as the plainXml slots of etl/rss2atom. Requiring at least one entry here made such a task impossible to run: provenance has no file to hash, so the manifest could never be written.
